titulo: Volvo’s plug-in hybrid XC60 and XC90 can really go the distance
cuerpo: Most plug-in hybrid electric vehicles (PHEV) today get an average of around 30-50 miles of battery-only range: decent, but not mind-blowing. With hybrid sales dominating the market today, Volvo is out to prove that its PHEVs can push the limits of what's possible.
